title: Item:Haywire's Voice
wikitext:
[[File:Haywire's Voice.png|thumb|300px|right|]]
'''Haywire's Voice''' is an in-quest item in [[the Vault of Night]] raid, absolutely required for the completion of the raid.

'''Description''': This contraption incorporates both magical and mundane components, and seems to alter the voice of its user.

'''Binding''': {{Bind|no|drops=both}}

'''In-quest use''':
* To gain the '''VOICE''', talk to [[Haywire]] at the beginning of the raid.
* Don't pick it up unless you know what to do with it.
* The person with the voice must talk to several magic mouths throughout the quest.
